full_name: Matthew Boyle | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Humanities William and Flora Hewlett Foundation Fellow Harvard University
bio: Matthew Boyle is a professor of philosophy at Harvard University. He works both on topics in the philosophy of mind and on some issues in the history of philosophy. In the former area, he has been especially concerned with the question of how we know our own minds and with debates about the scope and limits of such knowledge.
